smartLinkTemplate.intro: Paste this link into your sequence: every prospect who clicks lands with no form, with their own tracking.
smartLinkTemplate.undocumented: Check the variable names in your tool's editor. Only the email matters: company and first name are a bonus.
smartLinkTemplate.webhook: To pause the sequence as soon as a prospect reads, connect the <link>webhook</link>.
smartLinkTemplate.followupsOn: Clozer drafts a follow-up based on what each reader read, for you to approve. Remove the matching step from your sequence, or the prospect gets two.
smartLinkTemplate.followupsOff: Off: your sending tool does the follow-ups. Turn them on only if you remove a step from your sequence.
smartLinkTemplate.followupsFailed: The setting wasn't saved. Try again.
smartLinkTemplate.repliesHint: Clozer can't see replies to your sequence emails: they land in your inbox. To make it stop its follow-ups and tell you, have your tool (webhook, or Zapier / Make) POST to this address on every reply, unsubscribe or bounce: '{'"email": "…", "event": "replied"'}'. Keep it private: it works for your whole workspace.
smartLinkTemplate.repliesRotated: New address: the old one no longer works. Update it in your tool.
smartLinkTemplate.testHint: Open this link in a private window, without signing in: signed in, Clozer knows it's you and counts nothing. The reader it creates has your address: it's marked as a test, with no follow-up and no figures. Don't use your tool's test send: it fills the variables with a real prospect.
